p.i: audiebat (ut supra diximus) propter Gabaonitas id accidere. Fideles aliquando incidunt in varios errores & scelera, nec pos-sunt verbo Dei in via revocari, donec Deus afflictionibus aliquibus eos emolliat. Ex 2. Amos Prophetæ audivimus, Deum dicere, quòd tametsi populum cibi inopia & potionis afflixerit, nondum tamen ad ipsum reversus sit, idq; [?] repetit. Unde colligimus, Deum famem ideo terris immittere, ut homines ad ipsum convertantur. Quemadmodum equos si incitato cursu feruntur, aut à via exorbi-tent, fræno retrahimus, ita Deus nos fame alijsq; [?] ærumnis in viam retrahit. Si puer aliquis fugam meditetur, aut jussus scholam frequentare nolit, mittuntur nuntij, qui eum de via retrahant: ita Deus suos habet nuntios, famem, morbos, qui nos ad Patrem nostrum & Præceptorem reducant.

page.notes: The abbreviations "idq;" and "alijsq;" carry a superscript mark that is hard to read; marked [?]. The margin note "Deus fidem probat." is partly overprinted, so "fidem" is uncertain. The "2." in the margin is a bare reference number, written as its own note. The "Ex 2." in the text is printed as a small numeral. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot.
